---
title: "Tutorials Overview"
lang: en-US
---

This section provides hands-on tutorials for working with `SimilaritySearchEngine.jl`:

- **[Getting Started](getting-started.qmd)**: A comprehensive walkthrough using paragraphs from Mary Shelley's *Frankenstein*. Demonstrates:
  - Dense vector similarity search using LSI-derived embeddings with `SearchGraph`.
  - Sparse vector indexing with `InvertedFile`.
  - Full-text retrieval with BM25 and TF-IDF models.
  - Logical soft deletions and metadata filtering.
  - Target recall calibration via `calibrate!`.
  - Transactional persistence (closing and reopening projects).
  - Whole-dataset metric operations (`allknn`, `fft`, `closestpairs`, `bichromatic_kclosestpairs`).

- **[Multilingual Paragraph Search](paragraph-search.qmd)**: A large-scale tutorial indexing four corpora across three languages (English, Spanish, Portuguese Project Gutenberg collections, and English Wikipedia). Demonstrates:
  - Fitting and configuring linguistic profiles (`TextProfile`).
  - Orthographic query variant resolution and semantic query expansion.
  - Empirical benchmarking of indexing throughput, memory overhead, and search latency.
